Trait.Name: Brewing trait
Trait.Hint: The trait of the action roll a character makes to brew a potion.

Book.Name: Recipe book
Book.Label: Open the recipe book
Book.Hint: Potion recipes, and which items count as alchemy ingredients and vessels.

Craft.Title: Alchemy: {actor}
Craft.NoActor: Select a token or assign a character to brew
Craft.DisabledGM: Alchemy is off for this character: players do not see this window. Turn it on in the alchemy settings.
Craft.NoRecipes: The character knows no recipes yet.
Craft.DropIngredients: Drag ingredients here from the sheet or the list on the right; you choose how many (Shift: all that fit)
Craft.DropVessel: Drag a vial or a bottle here
Craft.PickRecipe: Pick a recipe on the left.
Craft.NoIngredients: No alchemy ingredients in the inventory.
Craft.NoVessels: No vials or bottles in the inventory.
Craft.NotReady: Put in all the ingredients and a vessel first
Craft.ItemsGone: Some of the ingredients or the vessel are no longer in the inventory
Craft.NotOwnItem: Only this character's own items can go into the potion
Craft.DoesNotFit: {name}: the recipe needs no more of it
Craft.GMRecipesHint: GM: the whole book is shown. Tick the recipes this character knows (known: {count}); the player sees only those.
Craft.BookEmpty: The recipe book is empty: add recipes there (module settings).
Craft.OtherItemsHint: Mark an item as an alchemy ingredient or a vessel. The mark goes by name, for every character.
Craft.MarkQuestion: {name} is not marked yet. What is it?
Craft.NoEquipmentModule: The Mist Age - Equipment is off: the variant potion cannot be hidden
Craft.MixActive: Mixed with {vessel}: its own outcome table ({potion})
Craft.HasMix: This alcohol changes the result of the selected recipe
Craft.AlcoholBlocked: {recipe} cannot be mixed with alcohol: {name} does not fit
Craft.AlcoholBlockedHint: This recipe cannot be mixed with alcohol
Craft.MixActivePlayer: Mixed with {vessel}: the result is unknown until you learn it

Chat.EnhancedMissing: The recipe has no enhanced version: the GM decides how this potion is stronger.
Chat.HiddenForGM: {actor} got {real}, hidden as "{shown}". Identify it in the item's settings when the time comes.

failureHope.Label: Failure with Hope
failureHope.Text: The potion comes out, but with side effects. It may still be useful.

failureFear.Label: Failure with Fear
failureFear.Text: The potion comes out, but with negative consequences of the GM's choosing.

Book.Title: Recipe Book
Book.DropPotion: Drop a potion item here to add its recipe
Book.RemoveConfirm: Remove the recipe "{name}"? Characters who know it will forget it.
Book.MaterialsHint: Items are matched by name, so copies already in the characters' inventories count too.
Book.DropVessel: Drop a vial, a bottle of alcohol and so on
Book.NotAlcohol: Not alcohol (click to mark as alcohol)

Editor.Title: Recipe: {name}
Editor.EnhancedHint: Drop a potion given on a critical success
Editor.NamedHint: Particular ingredients the recipe needs, besides the ones of any kind:
Editor.DropNamed: Drop an ingredient here (again to need one more)
Editor.VariantsHint: Optional. A variant is given hidden: unidentified, under the recipe potion's name and picture, with its description and features concealed until the GM identifies it (the Equipment module's mystery items). An outcome without a variant gives the recipe potion.

result.Label: Potion by the recipe
result.Hint: Success with Hope; also any outcome without its own variant

Editor.MixesHint: Drop a bottle of alcohol to give this recipe its own outcome table when that alcohol is the vessel. An empty slot gives the recipe potion. On alcohol every outcome comes out hidden, until the character knows that combination.
Editor.MixResultHint: Success with Hope on this alcohol
Editor.DropMix: Drop a bottle of alcohol here
Editor.BlockAlcoholHint: This recipe refuses vessels marked as alcohol in the materials: only a vial and other non-alcohol vessels can be used.
Editor.ResearchHint: Learning this recipe from a sample. Leave empty to go by rarity (the placeholder shows that value).

Actor.Title: Alchemy: {actor}
Actor.EnabledHint: Players see the Alchemy entry in the sheet's menu only when this is on.
Actor.RecognisedHint: Hidden by-products of brewing the character already knows: for each recipe, plain and on each alcohol, which result comes out. A ticked combination comes out identified. They cannot be brewed on purpose.
Actor.NoOutcomes: The recipes have no outcome variants yet.

Drop.NotItem: Drop an item or a folder of items

Recognised.Title: Recognised results: {actor}
Recognised.ToggleRow: Tick or untick the whole row

Research.ListHint: Potions you have a sample of, and projects you have started.
Research.Nothing: Nothing to research: get a sample of an unknown potion first.
Research.Pick: Pick a potion on the left.
Research.GainHint: The counter counts down to 0: critical −3, success with Hope −2, success with Fear −1, failure with Hope 0, failure with Fear +1
Research.Sample: A sample of {name} (first attempt only, it is spent)
Research.Hint: Each attempt spends the ingredients. Drag them here or click them on the right.
Research.NeedSample: The first attempt needs a sample of {name} in the inventory
Research.Failed: The research attempt failed, see the console

Hub.Title: Alchemy: characters
Hub.Hint: Every player character's alchemy at a glance; the buttons open their settings, alchemy window and recognised results.
